title: Quadratic bit on a single-coordinate vector
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$, every coordinate $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and every $c\in\mathbb{F}_2$, the complete quadratic bit of the vector that is $c$ at coordinate $i$ and zero elsewhere is $0$.
